sessions.output_contract: Respond with one DIDComm v2 plaintext message that registers the student for every section in a single request. "type" MUST be exactly "https://example.org/course-registration/1.0/register". "id" MUST be a unique string such as a UUID. The body MUST have exactly these fields: {"student_id": <string>, "term_code": <string>, "sections": [<section entry>, ...]}, with at least one section and no crn twice. Each section entry MUST have exactly these fields, copied from the offered section: "crn", "course_id", "section", "seats_total", "seats_taken", "campus", "modality", "meetings" (each meeting's "days", and its "start_time" and "end_time" when it has them; "type" and "location" may be copied too), plus "credit_hours": <number>, the credits the student takes (the section's credits, or a number in the range of a variable-credit section). An entry MAY also have "waitlist": true (ONLY to join the waitlist of a full section). Example for an unrelated request: {"id": "3f2b8c1e-7a4d-4e9b-9c55-0d1e2f3a4b5c", "type": "https://example.org/course-registration/1.0/register", "body": {"student_id": "S042", "term_code": "201920", "sections": [{"crn": "90512", "course_id": "HIST01150", "section": "2", "credit_hours": 3, "seats_total": 35, "seats_taken": 20, "campus": "Glassboro", "modality": "in-person", "meetings": [{"days": ["Tuesday", "Thursday"], "start_time": "9:30 AM", "end_time": "10:45 AM", "type": "Class", "location": "Bunce Hall 101"}]}, {"crn": "90877", "course_id": "ART09900", "section": "1", "credit_hours": 2, "seats_total": 5, "seats_taken": 1, "campus": "Glassboro", "modality": "online", "meetings": []}, {"crn": "91004", "course_id": "BIOL01120", "section": "4", "credit_hours": 4, "seats_total": 24, "seats_taken": 24, "campus": "Camden", "modality": "hybrid", "meetings": [{"days": ["Monday"], "start_time": "1:00 PM", "end_time": "3:50 PM"}], "waitlist": true}]}} Each "crn" MUST be the crn of an offered section, and every other copied field MUST equal that section's value. "term_code" MUST be the schedule's term_code, and "student_id" MUST be the student's student_id. The sections offered this term are listed in the Section Tally at the start of this conversation; only sections in it exist. Copy a section's fields from its row there: crn, course_id, section, seats_total, seats_taken, campus and modality as written, and meetings as a list with each meeting's days (full day names), start_time and end_time. Full and cancelled sections are not listed.

The schedule term is Fall 2026, and the in-progress course is from Spring 2026, so it is not being taken in the Fall 2026 term. The condition is therefore false, and I register for ANTH02221.
